desc:
🔥 YOUR MILITARY BASE WORKS OFFLINE!

[How to Play]  
- build and expand your own military base!  
- unlock new buildings that spawn powerful soldiers!  
- build tanks, aircraft, and a massive army!  
- capture every point on the map, including the strongest central zone!  
- earn cash, upgrade your base, and discover better units!  
- become the strongest commander and dominate the battlefield!

ENJOY THE GAME! REMEMBER, YOUR BASE WORKS OFFLINE!
